item.text:
I refactored the setup layer and the remaining hunter duplication.

The main structural change is a proper species registry: [SpeciesDefinition.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R002_module_java/SpeciesDefinition.java:6) and [SpeciesCatalog.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R002_module_java/SpeciesCatalog.java:8) now own species metadata like type, color, spawn probability, and factory. `Populator` no longer hardcodes that list in its own private structure; it just consumes the catalog in [Populator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R002_module_java/Populator.java:12). `Simulator` now creates the catalog once and shares it with both population setup and the view in [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R002_module_java/Simulator.java:33) and [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R002_module_java/SimulatorView.java:85), which removes the old `Populator`/view coupling.

I also pulled the duplicated prey-search loop into `Hunter` with a reusable helper in [Hunter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R002_module_java/Hunter.java:99). That let [Predator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R002_module_java/Predator.java:32) and [Scavenger.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R002_module_java/Scavenger.java:27) collapse down to their actual differences instead of each re-implementing the same adjacency scan.

Verification: `javac *.java` succeeds, and I removed the generated `.class` files afterward.
